title: Experienced Powerups
description: Provides a potion effect based on your experience level.
body:
Experienced Powerups is a datapack that grants players potion effects based on their experience levels.

Level Effects

Everyone collects experience at some point, but what if they could be used as a better resource? For every 10 levels, you get a potion effect. Ranging from simple utilities like jump boost to useful passives like resistance, rewarding the players for trying to get massive amounts of experience levels.

Effects that increases its function based on level will be able to stack up to 3 maximum but they do require a high experience level requirement to be met!
